name: Grupo Posadas, S.A.B. de C.V.
summary: Grupo Posadas, S.A.B. de C.V., together with its subsidiaries, owns, operates, leases, franchises, and manages hotels in Mexico and the Caribbean. It operates through Hotel Business; Vacation Club; and Hotel Management, Trademark Use and Others segments. The company operates hotels under the Live Aqua Beach Resort, Live Aqua Urban Resort, Live Aqua Devotion by Live Aqua, Grand Fiesta Americana, Fiesta Americana, Sunvivia by Fiesta Americana, The Explorean, Fiesta mericana, TheExplorean, FiestaInn, FiestaInnLoft, FiestaInnExpress, IOH, OneHotels, GammayCuramoria Collection brand name. Grupo Posadas, S.A.B. de C.V. was incorporated in 1967 and is based in Mexico City, Mexico.
